items.title: Terry McLaurin: Carted off with knee injury
items.text:
McLaurin left Monday night's game against the 49ers in the first quarter with a left knee injury, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Romeo Doubs: Expected back after bye
items.text:
Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: In line to run Tuesday
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) is expected to do some running Tuesday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.
